name: Bug report
about: Report a defect in the Studio 5000 AI Assistant
title: "BUG-NNN — "
labels: type:bug

<!--
Bugs are tracked as GitHub Issues + the "Studio 5000 AI Assistant" Project.
A maintainer assigns the sequential BUG-NNN id (edit it into the title), applies
severity:*/area:* labels, and sets the Severity/Area/Status Project fields.
SDK-interface (src/sdk_interface) issues are out of scope — the live SDK is
gated off by default and offline work targets the vendored src/acd parser.
-->

**Summary**
<!-- One sentence: what's broken. -->

**Area**
<!-- e.g. code_generator, ai_assistant, acd, l5x_analyzer, tag_analyzer, comment_graph, env/tests -->

**Severity**
<!-- Critical | High | Medium | Low -->

**Source (file:line, if known)**
<!-- e.g. src/ai_assistant/code_assistant.py:338 -->

**Repro / Trigger**
<!-- Steps or the tool call / input that produces the issue. -->

**Expected**
<!-- What should happen instead. -->

**Workaround**
<!-- Any manual step that avoids the problem, or "None". -->
